target.description: Binary word-volume decoding on the paper’s original Volume endpoint: distinguish top versus bottom RMS-intensity quartiles within each recording. This original endpoint is within the registration’s volume/speech/sentence scope; a result claims this endpoint only. Retain the original Volume electrode-count analysis alongside the 90-electrode Table 1 primary.

dataset.description: The original BrainTreebank intracranial movie recordings and word/audio annotations used for Table 1. Pin exact source-release and derived feature manifests before execution; a newer corpus version cannot silently replace them.

cohort.description: All seven source downstream pairs: sub_1/trial001, sub_2/trial006, sub_3/trial000, sub_4/trial000, sub_6/trial004, sub_7/trial000, sub_10/trial000. Table 6 identifies their held-out movies; three share Cars 2.

split.description: Original downstream train/validation/test proportions are .8/.1/.1, using random row splits and saved identities. Exact original word/feature row order and saved membership are not authenticated. Replacing them with the local support-disjoint split creates an extension.

inputs.description: Table 1 Volume comparison uses 90 clean Laplacian electrodes per participant with the original BrainBERT temporal embeddings and coordinates; preserve identical feature/checkpoint access and channel-ranking policy. A smaller ensemble is not the Table 1 task. Figure 3 Volume additionally uses the original 1, 10, 20, 30, 40 and 50 electrode conditions; the local 1/10/50/90 grid is not their replacement.

preprocessing.description: Author source specifies Laplacian rereferencing, 2048 Hz and five-second neural context; paper Appendix C defines per-word RMS with frame length 2048 and hop 512 and extreme-quartile labels. Exact feature timing, original ranked channel membership/order, ties, transcript alignment and native class mapping still need artifact-level reconciliation.

metric.description: Within each participant compute ROC-AUC, equivalently P(score_positive>score_negative)+0.5 P(tie), then source aggregation. Higher is better. F1 and local PopT-minus-linear gains do not replace the absolute PopT source score.

aggregation.description: Table 1 reports the mean ROC-AUC across source participants with standard error across subjects; for Volume, BrainBERT+pretrained PopT is 0.87 ± 0.03 at 90 channels. Preserve participant weighting, not pooled words.

full_panel.description: The registered Volume panel retains all seven subjects at the 90-electrode Table 1 BrainBERT comparison and at Figure 3 electrode counts 1, 10, 20, 30, 40 and 50. The recovered Table 1 pretrained-PopT and Linear rows include subject-mean ROC-AUC and descriptive subject SEM. Figure 3 requires every count for pretrained PopT, non-pretrained PopT, Linear and Deep NN, with original per-subject outputs, count effects and source uncertainty displays. All 24 curve ordinates and their exact dispersion convention remain unrecovered; completeness of any additional Table 1 Volume control rows must be reconciled with the original table before eligibility. Neither the prospective 1/10/50/90 evaluator nor one method's 49-run binder establishes complete original finding coverage.

permitted_observations.description: Use only original BrainTreebank recordings and word/audio annotations for the seven registered downstream subject/trial pairs, the original BrainBERT representations/coordinates and permitted pretrained access, and the original saved random-row training/validation/test identities and selected channel ensembles. Preserve the source five-second neural context and validation-based model selection; label/reference artifacts remain operator-controlled at final scoring. The two information conditions receive the same paper/data/feature/checkpoint and exposure package; author code is the sole added information in the +code condition. Pretraining includes downstream subjects, so this is not an unseen-subject or independently replicated unseen-movie evaluation. Exact exposed-data, pretrained-access and row/channel manifests remain unresolved.
